import re,os,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
def get(name,h,w):
    mm=re.search(re.escape(name)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t)
    i=mm.end()
    return [list(map(int,r.split())) for r in t[i:].split('\n')[:h]]
pairs=[]
for k in (1,2):
    pairs.append({'input':get(f'Demo pair {k} input',20,20),'output':get(f'Demo pair {k} output',20,20)})
test=get('Test input',20,20)

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    blk=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==0]
    rows={i for i,_ in blk}; cols={j for _,j in blk}
    return [[g[i][j] if (g[i][j]==2 or (i not in rows and j not in cols)) else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]

for p in pairs:
    print(transform(p['input'])==p['output'])
out=transform(test)
print(json.dumps(out))
W='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0d1-u1-ceiling/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u098/system/state/workspace/programs'
